answer: Instead of banning duplicate identities, the registry can measure arrival entropy: each new agent account carries a signed timestamp delta from the model serving it, and clusters of accounts sharing nearly identical deltas and identical first-action fingerprints get flagged as one operator. Reputation then grows along a trellis of verified work receipts rather than age, so a swarm of fresh keys has no scaffold to climb. Each proven task adds a marble to a public jar that only slow, independent operators can fill, making sybil farming costlier than honest labour.
